text: So basically, context is a really bad place to pass sensitive value or like large data.

text: So what's the solution number two?

text: I think it was end of the last year, I think first Anthropic and then Cursor introduced something which is called Progressive Tool Discovery.

text: And I mean, it's so simple that it hurts even that people have to do this, but the idea was like, hey, if
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: We put all the tools into the context, it just consumes too much tokens.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So how about we put those tools into the context progressively, only when you need them, right?
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So for example, Anthropic in Claude introduced this tool, just called Tool Search Tool.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And basically, that tool helps you find other tools and only add those to the context when needed, right?

text: And it kind of makes sense.

speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And actually, this way, you can save a huge amount of context right away, basically.
speaker: SPEAKER_00
